pages.text: A big water-play tub stood in the yard. The children splashed water about.
Lala wanted to splash in the water too. But Lala's feet stepped backward all by themselves.
Lala crouched beside the tub. "I will not get in." Only fingertips dipped lightly into the water.
Lala watched the children from outside the tub, rubbing toes against the dry ground.
The sun sank. The children climbed out and dried themselves with towels.
Not a bit of Lala's fur was wet. Lala pouted.
The next day, Teacher Bau sat beside the tub, dipped a foot in with a splash, and looked at Lala.
Lala dipped toes into the water. It felt lukewarm and tickly.
Lala plunged into the tub. Water drops flew toward the sky.
